visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and bangs stands in a brightly lit room. She wears a white collared shirt under a light beige knit vest. She holds a smartphone in her left hand, gesturing with her right hand while her mouth moves in an expressive manner. Behind her is a white brick wall and a yellow sofa. (2) The scene cuts to a digital screen capture of a mobile website interface featuring images of traditional Chinese deities and various buttons. A red button labeled 'See Matchmaker' is prominent. The lighting transitions to flat interface brightness. (3) The woman is now seen in a full-body shot kneeling on a gray patterned rug. She is draped in a large orange textured blanket and wears exaggerated glasses with pink and chocolate donut frames. She performs a deep bowing gesture toward her smartphone placed on the floor. (4) The screen capture returns, showing a list of four options with red text and white backgrounds. A finger-tap highlight appears over the option for 'Single looking for a partner.' The interface layout is clean with cultural motifs. (5) An animation of a wooden fortune stick container appears on the screen, followed by a 'Bua Buei' (divination blocks) animation. The blocks land in a specific orientation on a dark background showing temple statues. (6) A fortune poem is displayed on screen with red borders. Cartoon lightning bolt graphics flash over the image as the text reveals a 'Lower-Lower' result. The woman returns to the frame, removing her donut glasses and looking directly into the lens with a frustrated facial expression before turning away.

The BGM remains constant in the background while the female voice maintains a high-arousal, friendly tone with wide pitch variability. The female narrator explains the steps of the online process with clear articulation and consistent conversational volume. (4) A loud, synthetic thunder and lightning impact SFX occurs as the fortune result is revealed. The narrator's tone shifts to a humorous, mock-disappointed register with exaggerated falling intonation and increased intensity. The main female voice responds with a high-energy, rapid-fire sequence of short phrases before the audio abruptly hard-cuts to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous promotional showcase for the online fortune-telling service provided by the Taipei Xiahai City God Temple. It uses a comedic narrative where the creator seeks a romantic partner through the system, only to receive a 'bad luck' result, thereby engaging the audience through relatable humor while demonstrating the service's features.
